bee_activity_warning.message: Wind speeds above 25 mph significantly reduce bee flight activity and pollination efficiency.

before: Secure bee hives and straps before wind event.
Inspect young trees and support stakes.
during: Avoid pesticide spraying due to drift risk.
Limit orchard traffic during peak gusts.
after: Inspect for limb damage or fallen branches.
Reassess pollination effectiveness if wind occurred during bloom.
Document affected blocks for yield tracking.

notes: Wind speeds above 25 mph reduce bee activity during bloom.
Sustained winds above 30 mph can cause blossom drop and structural stress.
Gusts above 40 mph present elevated risk of limb damage and hive displacement.
Bloom stage is the most economically sensitive period for wind-related pollination disruption.
